question: Will Yisrael Beiteinu win less than 5% of the vote in the 2026 Knesset elections?
resolution_criteria: Yes if Yisrael Beiteinu's list gets under 5% of valid votes in the October 27, 2026 election, counted whether or not it passes the threshold. Resolves with Polymarket market will-yisrael-beiteinu-win-less-than-5-percent-of-the-vote-in-the-2026-knesset-elections.

history.rationale: Sprint forecast for fast resolutions. No independent news view: this is the market price 10.0% with the standing favorite-longshot rule (prices under 10% or over 90% moved 30% closer to the edge, in between left as is). It tests whether that rule beats the market.
10/27/2026 update, same method as the sprint: market price 20.2% with the favorite-longshot rule (under 10% or over 90% moved 30% closer to the edge, floor 1%). No independent news view.

resolution.post_mortem: Resolved no. Our last number was 20.2%; the market's last saved price before archival was 0.80%. Brier 0.041. Yisrael Beytenu won 5.93% of valid votes. Official CEC results certified 2026-11-04 (israelvote.meforum.org, israelnationalnews.com/news/435272): Likud 27, Yashar 21, Together 12, Joint List 11, Democrats 8, Raam 8, Yisrael Beytenu 7 (5.93%), Otzma 7, UTJ 7, Shas 6, RZ-Zehut 6; Netanyahu bloc 53, opposition 48, Arab parties 19; Amcha Yisrael 1.68%, below the threshold.
